text:
emma_cs: Quick sync — SailPoint pilot sent post-onboard asks. Need product triage so CS can update renewal playbook.

emma_cs: Copied short list:
```
1) per-route/campaign billing split
2) org-scoped embeddings export
3) nightly on-prem sync for air-gapped agents
4) simpler first-run Console flow + sample prompts
5) admin RBAC for teams
```

noah_pm: Which are blockers for go-live/renewal?

emma_cs: #1 and #3 are blockers; #5 is needed for provisioning; #2/#4 are nice-to-have. Renewal in ~5 weeks — finance wants billing clarity. :rotating_light:

rachel_prod: One-line impact notes: #1 prevents correct invoices; #3 blocks security signoff; #5 reduces admin overhead; #2 saves analytics time; #4 reduces support volume.

adam_eng: Ballpark t-shirt: #1 -> 2 devs x 4-6w; #3 -> 3 devs x 6-8w; #5 -> 1 dev x 2w; #2 -> 1 dev x 1-2w; #4 -> 1 designer+1 dev x 2w.

noah_pm: Priority from product side: 1 > 3 > 5 > 2 > 4. Can CS offer stopgaps so they don't pause renewal?

emma_cs: Offered daily CSV split export and a signed test attestation for on-prem. Customer says CSV is clumsy but usable for up to 6 weeks if we commit to roadmap.

triage-bot: Created RD-5222: "SailPoint: campaign billing interim export + spike" assigned to @adam_eng.

adam_eng: I'll add an API-first spike to RD-5222 to avoid Console work and try to shave ~2w. Will include acceptance criteria and migration notes.

noah_pm: Add Impact/Effort to roadmap: #1 Impact=9 Effort=8, #3 Impact=8 Effort=9, #5 Impact=6 Effort=2, #2 Impact=5 Effort=2, #4 Impact=4 Effort=2.

emma_cs: I'll ask SailPoint to rank items 1-5 and confirm CSV interim acceptance by EOD and paste here.

emma_cs: SailPoint replied: ranking = 1,3,5,2,4. They accept CSV interim if we provide a commit window within 3 weeks. Renewal risk = "elevated" if #1 not committed.

noah_pm: Actions: emma -> capture written CSV acceptance and add to renewal tracker; adam -> spike RD-5222; noah -> update roadmap and schedule 30m grooming. Closing thread until spike posted.
